The bar is 64 cells... if the bar is time, then 64 cells for 7764 seconds? That doesn't fit with 1-2 cells per action.
Hmm, wait, actually maybe the bar is decreasing per action, and the amount of decrease is the "cost" of the action. A click on the yellow handle cost 1, and a click on the black bar cost 2? That seems arbitrary.
Let me look at the small c/Y object again. Maybe that's the "player" and I need to click it to move it. Let me try clicking on it.
No, wait. Let me reconsider the whole scene. Maybe this is a "Tangram"-style puzzle: the small c/Y object is a piece that needs to be moved to the black bar (like a key into a lock)? The yellow segment on the bar might be the "slot."
